notes.title: Demo out now! View Update [0.65.0]
notes.notes:
Play the demo now, download it through our Steam Store Page! 
- This is different from launching the playtest method.

[0.65.0]
Released Practice Solo Mode:
- Play and practice as the Sins against crafty Human AI.

Envy:
Speed decreased by 10%

Greed:
- Additional items will impact less for the speed reduction when attacking.  

Satellite ontop of truck:
- [Interact] to view players on the map.
- Auto activates during 1v1s.

Wrath: 
- Can now pounce when grabbing onto a wall (Hold right click to aim and press space to pounce towards the direction your facing). Pouncing will launch the player much further than a regular wall jump.
- Will automatically attack if you have enough stamina when a player is infront of you during pouncing. 

General:
- Can now set your lobby to Text-Chat only as the host. Text-chat only mode will stop players from talking with their mic, requiring only text chat (Enter key to text chat). This can be toggled host lobby page, or in the options page prior to game starting.
- Players can now mute other players through the Lobby page in the pause menu.
- Can now limit Max Fps.
- Fixed issue of being able to sometimes hear spectators.
- Added more tooltips in options.
- Player's number will show when voting.
- Other minor improvements & bug fixes. 

Practice Solo Mode:
- Can now search for lobbies in the Pause menu during practice mode.
- Auto search for online lobbies option now available in the pause menu.
